entries.name: highway-adr
entries.description: Manages one architecture decision for one discovery.
entries.usage: Invoke as /highway-adr with one discovery id.

entries.name: highway-architecture
entries.description: Manages one reference architecture from one accepted adr.
entries.usage: Invoke as /highway-architecture with one adr id.

entries.name: highway-discovery
entries.description: Manages one discovery for a complete request.
entries.usage: Invoke as /highway-discovery with one request id or one discovery id.

entries.name: highway-help
entries.description: Prints registration details for one named skill, or a discovery listing of every registered skill when none is named.
entries.usage: Invoke as `/highway-help` for all skills, or `/highway-help <skill-id>` for one named skill's registration details.

entries.name: highway-implementation
entries.description: Manages one reference implementation from one accepted reference architecture.
entries.usage: Invoke as /highway-implementation with one architecture id.

entries.name: highway-objectives
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide business objective baseline and its stable traceability references.

entries.name: highway-onboarding
entries.description: Manages one decision, one reference architecture, and one reference implementation.

entries.name: highway-profile
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide organizational Profile and its contextual guidance.

entries.name: highway-request
entries.description: Manages one business request and its accepted artifact.
entries.usage: Invoke as /highway-request with the business change.

entries.name: highway-setup
entries.description: Orchestrates initial highway setup through the owning governance skills.
